description_en: Queries the information about a user
name: GetUser

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You can view your UID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console
parameters.help_zh: 用户UID。您可以通过DMS控制台右上角头像处查看您的UID
parameters.name: uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html operation to query the ID of the user
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: user_id

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败

CurExecuteCount.description_en: The number of queries that are performed on the current day

CurResultCount.description_en: The number of rows that are queried on the current day

DingRobot.description_en:
The DingTalk chatbot URL that is used to receive notifications.



The system returns this parameter if the user has set a DingTalk chatbot URL in the console. To set a DingTalk chatbot URL in the console, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner and click the Edit icon next to Notice.

The system does not return this parameter if the user has not set a DingTalk chatbot URL
DingRobot.description_zh:
钉钉机器人，用于接收消息通知。

如果您已经在控制台界面右上角头像处的通知里配置过钉钉机器人，此处将返回。
如果您没有配置过钉钉机器人，此处则没有返回

Email.description_en:
The email address that is used to receive notifications.



The system returns this parameter if the user has set an email address in the console. To set an email address in the console, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner and click the Edit icon next to Notice.

The system does not return this parameter if the user has not set an email address
Email.description_zh:
电子邮箱，用于接收消息通知。

如果您已经在控制台界面右上角头像处的通知里配置过电子邮箱，此处将返回。
如果您没有配置过电子邮箱，此处则没有返回

LastLoginTime.description_en: The last point in time when the user logged on to the console

MaxExecuteCount.description_en: The maximum number of queries that can be performed on the current day

MaxResultCount.description_en: The maximum number of rows that can be queried on the current day

Mobile.description_en:
The mobile number of the user.



The system returns this parameter if the user has set a mobile phone number in the console. To set a mobile phone number in the console, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner and click the Edit icon next to Notice.

The system does not return this parameter if the user has not set a mobile phone number
Mobile.description_zh:
用户手机号码。

如果您已经在控制台界面右上角头像处的通知里配置过手机号码，此处将返回。
如果您没有配置过手机号码，此处则没有返回

NotificationMode.description_en:
The notification method. The system returns one or more values. Valid values:

SMS: text message
EMAIL: email.
DINGDING: DingTalk.
DINGROBOT: DingTalk chatbot.
WEBHOOK: webhook
NotificationMode.description_zh:
消息通知方式，返回值可能为多个值，单个返回值说明如下：

SMS：短信
EMAIL：电子邮箱
DINGDING：钉钉
DINGROBOT：钉钉机器人
WEBHOOK：Webhook

ParentUid.description_en:
The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the user.

An Alibaba Cloud account can contain one or more RAM users
ParentUid.description_zh:
主账号UID。
同一主账号UID下包含多个子账号UID

items.description_en:
The ID of the role that is assigned to the user. Valid values:

1: a regular user role.
2: a database administrator (DBA) role.
3: a DMS administrator role.
4: a security administrator role.
6: a schema read-only user role
items.description_zh:
角色ID列表，具体角色ID的返回值说明如下：
1：表示角色为普通用户。
2：表示角色为DBA。
3：表示角色为管理员。
4：表示角色为安全管理员。
6：表示角色为结构只读

items.description_en:
The name of the role that is assigned to the user. Valid values:

USER: a regular user.
DBA : a DBA.
ADMIN: a DMS administrator.
SECURITY_ADMIN: a security administrator.
STRUCT_READ_ONLY: a schema read-only user
items.description_zh:
角色名称列表，具体的角色名称返回值说明如下：
USER：普通用户
DBA：DBA
ADMIN：管理员
SECURITY_ADMIN：安全管理员
STRUCT_READ_ONLY：结构只读

SignatureMethod.description_en:
The signature method that is used to secure connections when a webhook URL is used. Valid values:

NONE: no signature.
HMAC_SHA1: HMAC_SHA1
SignatureMethod.description_zh:
Webhook签名方式。返回值说明如下：
NONE：不签名
HMAC_SHA1：HMAC_SHA1

State.description_en:
The status of the user. Valid values:

NORMAL: The user is normal.
DISABLE: The user is disabled.
DELETE: The user is deleted
State.description_zh:
用户状态，返回值说明如下：
NORMAL：正常
DISABLE：禁用
DELETE：已删除

Webhook.description_en:
The webhook URL that is used to receive notifications.



If the user has set a webhook URL, DMS sends notifications to the specified URL.

The system does not return this parameter if the user has not set a webhook URL
Webhook.description_zh:
Webhook，用于接收消息通知。

如果您已经配置过Webhook，当DMS中有消息通知时，系统会将消息通知发送到您指定的URL地址。
如果您没有配置过，此处则没有返回
